item.title: Date Confirmed for Farnborough (A)
item.description: Following the postponement of our away fixture against Farnborough on Saturday due to a waterlogged pitch, we can now confirm that a new date has been arranged. The post Date Confirmed for Farnborough (A) appeared first on Dagenham & Redbridge FC.

item.title: Club Shop Open this Afternoon
item.description: You can come down to the Daggers Club Shop this afternoon to purchase your match tickets, home and away kits and other merchandise! The post Club Shop Open this Afternoon appeared first on Dagenham & Redbridge FC.

item.title: Daggers Celebrate Diversity Day 2026
item.description: Our Enterprise National League South home fixture against Chippenham Town on Saturday, 7th February, has been designated this season’s Daggers Celebrate Diversity Day. The post Daggers Celebrate Diversity Day 2026 appeared first on Dagenham & Redbridge FC.

item.title: Pre-Match Activities on Daggers Celebrate Diversity Day
item.description: Supporters attending Daggers Celebrate Diversity Day 2026 are encouraged to arrive early, with a range of pre-match activities taking place in the car park from 1 pm. The post Pre-Match Activities on Daggers Celebrate Diversity Day appeared first on Dagenham & Redbridge FC.

item.title: Pathway Programme Trial Announced
item.description: Dagenham & Redbridge FC are delighted to announce a trial morning for the next intake of our Pathway Programme. The trial will take place on Wednesday, 18th February at Leisure United Parsloes Park. The post Pathway Programme Trial Announced appeared first on Dagenham & Redbridge FC.

item.title: Ticket Information: Horsham (A)

item.title: Watch Horsham game live in the Dagger Bar or on DAZN
item.description: If you can’t make it to Horsham on Tuesday, we will be showing the game live in the Dagger Bar, with doors open from 4 pm. The post Watch Horsham game live in the Dagger Bar or on DAZN appeared first on Dagenham & Redbridge FC.

item.title: Fan Safety Ahead of Daggers Celebrate Diversity Day
item.description: Ahead of Daggers Celebrate Diversity Day, everyone at Dagenham & Redbridge looks forward to welcoming supporters to Victoria Road for our fixture against Chippenham and would like to remind fans of the measures in place to ensure a safe and enjoyable matchday for all. The post Fan Safety Ahead of Daggers Celebrate Diversity Day appeared first on Dagenham & Redbridge FC.
